During the [[Operation Skyhook]], the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] design team was '''captured''' by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Prelude==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military advisors [[Capture of the Omicron 1|captured]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] were unable to provide many details of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] Project except that the design team was lead by [[Bevel Lemelisk]]. They also knew that part of his team had recently traveled to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to meet with [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]]. The [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] decided to capture the design team. Although the loss of the design team couldn't slow the progress on the Death Star, their capture might have helped the rebellion interpret the technical readouts en route with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].

==The battle==
Part of the Death Star design team was on their way to a rendezvous with the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'' in the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Godar]]''.

While [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] engaged the [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Gunboat]] and [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] escorts, Farlander's [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] disabled the ''Godar''. A [[Rescue 1 (Lambda-class)|shuttle]] arrived in the system as soon as the corvette was disabled and boarded the corvette. With them was a squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] holding them as virtual prisoners. ''Rescue 1'' captured the personnel and fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
